title: 情绪识别
problem_statement_md:
假设一个机器人可以识别你的情绪，并标有代表每一种情绪的数字：

```text
1 - 你很高兴!
2 - 你很悲伤!
3 - 你很生气!
4 - 你很惊讶!
```

编写一个程序，将情绪的数字作为输入，并以示例格式输出相应的信息。
如果输入的是一个程序无法识别的情绪，它应该输出："unknown"。
problem_statement_en_md:
[s0l0!-header][h1]The switch Statement[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

Your robot can recognize your emotions marked with number that represents each of them:
1 - You are happy!
2 - You are sad!
3 - You are angry!
4 - You are surprised!
Write a program that takes the emotion number as input and outputs the corresponding message in given format.
If the input is an emotion that the program doesn’t know, it should output: "Unknown emotion.".

[b]Sample input[/b]
1

[b]Sample output[/b]
You are happy!

[note]Don't forget about the [b]break[/b] statement.[/note]
